notes.fountain_encoding: 0x02 = fountain (effect type determined by game engine, not ULT data). 0x05 = alternate fountain byte (L8 only, likely damage type).
notes.sign_encoding: Each level has one sign message indexed 1-8. Multiple 0x20 cells on one level all show the same message. Sign N uses clue string N-1 (0-indexed) from the trailing clue table.
notes.marks: Mark of Snake and Mark of Kings (L8) are not encoded as distinct ULT bytes. Likely hardcoded positions triggered by SEARCH command in game engine.
